FARLIGHT · UI REVIEW v135

The Far Drift — full interface suite · Freeholder era · docktown progression, block inventory, captain's station, comm channel, combat grid

01TITLE — FREEHOLD REGISTRY

Continue voyage leads when a save exists; full crew roster with the new portrait suite.

02TITLE — PORTRAIT

Phone-portrait flows as a single column: story, buttons, footer, crew.

03FLIGHT HUD

Rescaled universe: giant star, corona band, gravity, compass, readout panel.

04ORBIT — AUTO SCANS

Mineral and biosphere sweeps run themselves and persist; per-mineral colors with rarity grades.

05CAPTAIN'S STATION

Landed-ship cabin: live windshield (sky, ridgelines, weather, parked SR-2), console readout, DISEMBARK / LAUNCH.

06ROVER RUNS

Scanner fog, colored deposit glyphs, charge discipline — no solar top-up, the umbilical is everything.

07DOCKTOWN PROMENADE

Walkable strip with dressed storefronts: crates and scale, barred windows, hex racks, notice board, curio drapes, gantry sparks.

08OUTFITTER — BLOCK SYSTEM

Every purchase wears a drawn icon and its block footprint; stocks unlock in stages announced by the PA.

09GUNSMITH — MOUNTS

Weapons carry S/M/L mount chips and block grids; buys are blocked without a free mount of the right size.

10THE YARD

Hulls list their mount loadout (1S 1M 0L) beside speed, hold and agility.

11SHIP — GAUGE CLUSTER

Fuel, hull, shield and heat arcs; speed dial with needle; burn bar; cargo as filled blocks; schematic with 🔍 zoom.

12SYSTEMS — LOADOUT

The weapons rack lives here now (moved off Crew), with primary/secondary fitting.

13CREW

Realistic procedural portraits — face shapes, irises, hair, uniforms; Veil-born and Thessi anatomy.

14BESTIARY — CONTAINMENT WING

Full-height cage grid: every specimen drawn, scanline shimmer, rarity frames and aura rings.

15VOYAGE LOG

Ledger, alignment, refit progress bar across all upgrade tiers.

16COMM CHANNEL

Two portraits face off; a weak comms officer garbles the translation; posture is a slider; outcomes range from gifts to CHANNEL CLOSED.

17INTERCEPT

Reaver captain with dread warning, scan-fillable intel, comms strip and the 2-column option grid.

18COMBAT GRID

Starflight encounters: red grid border, the view zooms out as you flee; outrun them past the edge and you blink free.

19THE CHART

Every touched system, courses, fuel estimates, rich seams and first descents.

20THE POWERS

Veil, Kessen and Umbra portraits — calm and hostile variants.
